newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia PM sees more signs of faster growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia PM sees more signs of faster growth.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Friday there were more signs emerging daily that Australia's economy could grow faster.
"The growing signs that the capacity of the Australian economy to grow at a much faster rate are emerging every day," Howard told a public gathering.

Howard's remarks followed comments by Reserve Bank governor Ian Macfarlane on Tuesday that the bank did not have a growth ceiling and that the economy could grow 4.5 percent or more annually over the next few years without boosting inflation.
Howard also said he was very optimistic that Australia could overcome the challenge of reducing unemployment, which has been stagnant near 8.5 percent for two years.
Australia's economy grew 2.4 percent in the year to March. The government has projected 3.75 percent growth in fiscal 1997/98 (July-June).
